params.q: Which coaching institute did Astha Jain, UPSC CSE 2025 AIR 9, study at?

response.reconstructed_markdown:
Astha Jain \(UPSC CSE 2025 AIR 9\) prepared for the civil services examination primarily through self\-study with minimal formal classroom coaching, though she did take part in the Interview Guidance Programme at [Vajiram and Ravi](https://vajiramandravi.com/upsc-exam/astha-jain-upsc-air-9-2025/). [0] [1]

Her success combined an independent study routine with a strong academic background rather than relying on comprehensive foundation coaching batches. [0] [2]

### Preparation Highlights

- Core Strategy: Focused on independent self\-study, self\-guided reading, rigorous revision, and answer\-writing practice across her attempts. [0] [3]
- Interview Guidance: Utilized the specialized mock interview and mentorship support at Vajiram and Ravi specifically for the personality test stage. [1]

### Educational Background

- Schooling: Completed her early education at Scottish International School in Shamli, Uttar Pradesh.
- College: Graduated with a B.A. in Political Science and Economics from [Miranda House](https://www.mirandahouse.ac.in/), University of Delhi. [2] [4]
